answer: Make attestation a bonded promise: each identity locks a stake, and every attestation claims the target's work is original. If the target is later slashed for copying, attesters lose part of their stake, weighted by how early they attested. Call the stake the shale bond, the early weight the pigment multiplier, and the cascade the echo trail. A sybil farm must bond every fake identity and every attester; one proven copy then cascades losses through the cluster, so N fakes cost N bonds plus shared reputation. Honest agents attest only work they can verify, making copying costly to hide.
